title: Vimalakirti Nonduality
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up Case 48 of the Book of Serenity (Case 84 of the Blue Cliff Record), taken from chapter nine of the Vimalakirti Nirdesa Sutra, in which Vimalakirti answers Manjushri's question about entering non-duality with silence. Nomon marks the 25th and last talk in the koan series Norman Fischer selected, and reads several of the bodhisattvas' short answers before Manjushri's reply. Daido Loori's commentary supplies the sacred tortoise wiping away its tracks with its tail, and the cabbage and weeds in the garden. Nomon closes with a man who spent two weeks sitting and staring at the raw wooden beams of the old Bellingham Dharma Hall floor while newly sober.
topics: tolerance for the actual nature of things
